responsibility: Declares the tree-level object-size analysis interface used to optimize object-size builtins and related diagnostics/fortification logic. It defines the OST_* mode bits for subobject/minimum/dynamic queries and exposes initialization, teardown, builtin-size computation, and declaration-initial-size helpers implemented by tree-object-size.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the object-size analysis interface and mode bits such as OST_SUBOBJECT/OST_MINIMUM/OST_DYNAMIC. Unlike gcc/tree-object-size.cc, it is the API/constant definition header rather than the builtin-size computation and optimization-pass implementation.
